name: healthchecks
summary: [Healthchecks](https://github.com/healthchecks/healthchecks) is a watchdog for your cron jobs. It's a web server that listens for pings from your cron jobs, plus a web interface.

env.name: SECRET_KEY
env.description: A secret key used for cryptographic signing. Will generate a random value if one is not supplied and save it to `/config/local_settings.py`.

env.name: SITE_ROOT
env.description: The site's top-level URL and the port it listens to if different than 80 or 443 (e.g., https://healthchecks.example.com:8000).

env.name: ALLOWED_HOSTS
env.description: A comma-separated list of valid hostnames for the server. Default is the domain portion of `SITE_ROOT`.

env.name: APPRISE_ENABLED
env.description: Set to `True` to enable the Apprise integration (https://github.com/caronc/apprise).

env.name: CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
env.description: A [list](https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/introduction.html#lists) of trusted origins for unsafe requests (e.g. POST). Defaults to the value of `SITE_ROOT`.

env.name: DEBUG
env.description: Set to `False` to disable. Debug mode relaxes CSRF protections and increases logging verbosity but should be disabled for production instances as it will impact performance and security.

env.name: INTEGRATIONS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS
env.description: Defaults to False. Set to True to allow integrations to connect to private IP addresses.

env.name: PING_EMAIL_DOMAIN
env.description: The domain to use for generating ping email addresses. Defaults to `localhost`.

env.name: RP_ID
env.description: If using webauthn for 2FA set this to match your Healthchecks domain. Webauthn will only work over https.

env.name: SITE_LOGO_URL
env.description: Full URL to custom site logo.

docs.setup:
Access the WebUI at <your-ip>:8000. For more information, check out [Healthchecks](https://github.com/healthchecks/healthchecks).

See [here](https://healthchecks.io/docs/self_hosted_configuration/) for a complete list of available environment variables.

changelog.text: No longer write envs to local_settings.py. Envs will take precedence over any existing values in config file. Removed `REGENERATE_SETTINGS` as it is now obsolete.
Rebase to Alpine 3.17. Add extra deps for pycurl. Add INTEGRATIONS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_IPS.
Add curl-dev to fix broken pip builds.
Rebase to Alpine 3.16, migrate to s6v3.
Fix CSRF setting for Django 4.0 (introduced in v1.25.0)
Add Apprise to Docker as in v1.24.0
Update custom logo handling to support changes in v1.22.0
Add libffi-dev to allow building of python cryptography lib.
Rebasing to alpine 3.12, fixed 'ALLOWED_HOSTS' bug, now defaults to wildcard
Add postgres client and fix config for CSRF.
Switching to new Base images, shift to arm32v7 tag.
Adding mysql libs needed for using a database.
adding pipeline logic and multi arching release
`git pull` is now in Dockerfile so each tagged container contains the same code version
